title: University of St Andrews
description: The University of St Andrews' official design guidelines define the primary colours St Andrews Blue (#00539B), St Andrews Red (#EE312A), St Andrews Yellow (#FFDF00) and St Andrews Black (#231F20), and the secondary colours Light Blue (#00AEEF), Mid Blue (#007DC5), Burgundy (#C60C46), Purple (#7B439A), Orange (#F5842B), Green (#54B948), Mid Green (#00853F) and Dark Green (#005953).
